name: Barbuda
summary: A long English lease with a lasting legacy for land and community.
notes: The Codrington family were proprietors under the English crown, not a separate empire. Barbuda’s track does not inherit Antigua’s French occupations.

events.title: English settlement
events.detail: A colony was established before Barbuda became a dependency of Antigua.

events.title: The Codrington lease
events.detail: The crown leased the island to the Codrington family.

events.title: United administratively with Antigua
events.detail: Barbuda was joined to Antigua within the British colonial system.

events.title: The proprietary lease ends
events.detail: The Codrington lease was surrendered to the crown.

events.title: Independence with Antigua
events.detail: Barbuda became part of the sovereign state of Antigua and Barbuda.
